# Official BIS responses

`japan_daily.csv` and `japan_monthly.csv` are unmodified BIS responses, not
synthetic fixtures. Source requests, capture times and SHA-256 hashes are in
`manifest.json`. Tests use their fixed values and metadata without external I/O.

These are current snapshots captured in October 2026, not evidence of what was
published in January 2025. Compilation notes may refer to later policy changes.

Source: BIS. Statistical data are subject to the
[BIS terms of permitted use](https://data.bis.org/help/legal), independently of
the MIT license for this library's original source code.

The four JSON fixtures are unmodified official dataflow, DSD, codelist and
availability responses captured on 2026-11-02 (Asia/Tehran). Their request URLs,
Accept headers and hashes are in `metadata_manifest.json`.
